text_zh: 来华旅行可选择手机支付、银行卡或人民币现金；银行卡是否受理看商户标识，不把手机支付当唯一办法。
text_en: In mainland China, payment options include mobile payments, bank cards and RMB cash. Check merchant acceptance signs; a payment app is not the only option.

text_zh: 铁路票可用护照在12306英文网站或应用办理实名核验和购票，乘车带购票证件原件；景区预约规则另查。
text_en: For mainland rail tickets, verify your passport through 12306 English and book there. Carry the original booking document. Attraction reservations have separate rules.

text_zh: 地铁单程票可在站内窗口或售票机购买；乘铁路或高铁带购票证件原件，可按现场指引走人工核验通道。支付方式问站员。
text_en: Buy metro single-journey tickets at station counters or machines. For mainland rail or high-speed trains, bring your original booking document; manual ticket checks are available. Ask staff about payment methods.

text_zh: 可带护照到电信、移动或联通营业厅申请手机卡；套餐和设备适用情况先问营业厅。
text_en: Apply for a SIM with your passport at a China Telecom, China Mobile or China Unicom service office. Confirm the plan and device suitability there.

text_zh: 在中国内地，遭人身侵害或财产案件拨110，火灾拨119，需要急救拨120。
text_en: In mainland China, call 110 for assault or property crime, 119 for fire, and 120 for emergency medical help.

text_zh: 可在手机上安装微信、支付宝或云闪付，用境外或中国手机号注册后按提示绑定银行卡；可绑定带 Visa、万事达、银联、美国运通、JCB、大来或发现标识的银行卡。境外银行卡绑定须经发卡行验证，失败时咨询支付产品客服或发卡行；支持的卡种、限额和收费因产品而异，以产品页面提示和服务协议为准。
text_en: Install WeChat, Alipay or UnionPay on your phone, register with a foreign or Chinese mobile number and follow the prompts to link a bank card; cards with Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay, American Express, JCB, Diners Club or Discover logos can be linked. Linking an overseas card needs verification by the issuer; if it fails, ask the payment product’s customer service or your bank. Supported card brands, limits and fees vary by product; see the product’s prompts and service agreement.

text_zh: 可在有兑换标识的商业银行网点、外币兑换点，以及国际机场、陆路口岸、港口等入境口岸和境内其他地方有兑换标识的自助兑换机，把外币换成人民币现金；也可用国际银行卡在 ATM 上取人民币现金。商业银行网点还可兑换小面额人民币。
text_en: Foreign currency can be exchanged for RMB cash at commercial bank outlets, money changers and self-service exchange machines marked with an Exchange logo at international airports, land ports, seaports and other entry ports and elsewhere in China, and RMB cash can be withdrawn with an international bank card at ATMs. Commercial bank outlets also exchange small RMB notes.

text_zh: 可用支付宝（出行→打车）、微信（我→服务→出行）或滴滴国际版叫网约车；滴滴国际版支持用境外手机号和国际信用卡注册。
text_en: Ride-hailing can be booked in Alipay (Transport → Taxi), WeChat (Me → Services → Mobility) or the Didi-Greater China app, which accepts foreign phone numbers and international credit cards for sign-up.

text_zh: 火车票可在 12306 英文网站、12306 应用或车站售票窗口改签和退票；按改签、退票时间可能收取手续费。
text_en: Rail tickets can be changed or refunded on the 12306 English website, the 12306 app or at a station ticket office. Service fees may apply depending on when you change or cancel.

text_zh: 护照丢失请立即向当地派出所报案。在车站售票窗口、代售点或车上购买火车票时，可使用护照报失证明，或本国驻华使领馆签发并附有效签证或停留证件的临时旅行证件。
text_en: If you lose your passport, report it to the local police station immediately. For rail tickets at station ticket offices, agents or on trains, a passport loss report certificate, or a temporary travel document from your embassy or consulate in China with a valid visa or stay certificate, can be used.

text_zh: 手机套餐的流量通常有限；用量少时可在不用时关闭移动数据，用量大时向运营商咨询合适的流量套餐。
text_en: Mobile plans often include limited data. If you use little, switch mobile data off when not needed; if you need a lot, ask the telecom operator for a suitable data plan.
